notes.title: Gamescom 2023 All Wrapped Up!
notes.notes: Thank you to everyone who made Gamescom this year great! We had the offline Gamescom demo available as a playtest for the past few weeks leading up to, and then during, the convention. Today we are deactivating access and will remove the playtest shortly to work on the online multiplayer. Stay on the lookout on our Discord and here on Steam for our next online playtest in the works. Thanks again for everyone's support!

notes.title: Gamescom Playtest Speed Run Competition
notes.notes:
Hi Descenders,

In celebration of being at Gamescom this year, our steam page will have the offline Gamescom demo up for anybody to play! Solve the dungeon's puzzles and find the extraction door. After extraction, a screen will appear with the time remaining on your countdown timer. 

Take a screen shot of the extraction screen and post it within our Discord text channel "#speed-run-contest-gamescom2023". Fastest time will win a branded coffee mug or water bottle from our online shop! In case of a tie, a winner will be randomly selected from tied contestants. 

https://discord.gg/exodusofdescent

See you all in the dungeon and at Gamescom, Escape Your Descent!

Regards,
TheCrisp11

notes.title: Thank You 200+ Players!
notes.notes:
The game was open to the public for players to try out an early pre-alpha playtest build of the game during Steam's Next Fest week. 

During this time, valuable feedback was gathered from those who participated and joined the community on Discord. We hadn't done much marketing, so most of these players joined due to word of mouth. 

Again, thanks to all 200+ people who joined us! Be on the lookout for another playtest next month, and we hope to see you all again in the dungeon!

notes.title: Steam Pre-Alpha Playtest #1
notes.notes:
Yooper Game Studios LLC is looking to test a new build of the game in preparation for Steam Summer Fest this June! May's playtest event is our second public playtest overall, but first playtest running through Steam. 

Keys to download and play will be available on our [url=https://discord.gg/exodusofdescent]Discord[/url] page, so subscribe to the channel if you haven't already to stay up-to-date with the latest news!
